results.name: Home network only
results.desc: capacity and responsiveness between this laptop and the Operator Console, over Wi-Fi or cable, without the internet

capacity.method: RFC 9097 method (load-rate adjustment from 50 ms feedback, maximum of 1 s sub-intervals); IntentQoS messages, not the RFC 9946 UDPST protocol

rpm.note: draft-ietf-ippm-responsiveness-09 formula: (60000/mean(TM(tcp_f),TM(tls_f),TM(http_f)) + 60000/TM(http_l)) / 2, TM = trimmed mean dropping the worst 5 %; download load, 4 connections, intervals of 5 s, stability over the last 4

scenarios.name: Work call while a backup uploads

scenarios.metric: capacity and responsiveness to the Operator Console
scenarios.name: Home network only

summary: Work call while a backup uploads: delay p99 80 → 63 ms
note: Delay = reply time of small UDP packets (DNS queries to the public resolvers 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8 and 9.9.9.9, 10 a second in a steady stream, like a call or a game) while the load runs. It includes every queue between this laptop and the internet, which is what calls and games feel. 'IntentQoS off' uses the router's no-QoS test window (shaping removed, restored automatically).
